historical_result_policy: The v3 and v4 matrices remain immutable provenance. Pricing-prompt pilots v5-v8 are development evidence and are not pooled with the final v5-protocol matrix.
change_reason: correct the false assumption that transaction volume is invariant to buy and sell multipliers
make selfish pricing and evaluator feedback conditional on observed charging and V2G volume
cover equivalent adjacent price periods because the MILP can shift dispatch between them
enforce an Evaluator's explicit structured adjustment when the Pricing Agent's numeric array contradicts its own explanation
retain the best solver-usable schedule so a one-rerun incentive test cannot replace a better candidate

design.analysis: descriptive difference in repeated-episode means within each case-mode cell; development pilots are excluded

controls.causal_interval_settlement: settle interval t before the decision and optimize t+1 through 48
controls.candidate_selection: best solver-usable mode-aligned projected-full-day result; acceptance breaks objective ties only
controls.feedback_compliance_guard: enforce only the Evaluator's explicit structured side, direction, executable window, and target when a rerun array is numerically noncompliant

outcomes.selfish_score: realized aggregator revenue; higher is better
outcomes.altruistic_score: negative realized full-day PTO cost; higher is better
